chunks: O Prophet, when believing women come to you and swear on oath that they will not associate anything with God, nor steal, nor fornicate, nor kill their children, nor accuse others for what they have fabricated themselves, nor disobey you in any rightful thing, then you should accept their allegiance, and ask forgiveness of God for them. Certainly God is forgiving and kind.
ai.seo_question: What are the specific conditions of the women's pledge of allegiance in Surah Al-Mumtahanah?
ai.summary: Known as the 'Verse of the Pledge' (Ayat al-Bay'ah), this passage establishes the formal covenant between the Prophet and believing women, emphasizing that spiritual equality in obedience does not negate distinct social roles. Shia exegetes highlight the specific prohibitions—such as infanticide and slander—as corrections to pre-Islamic Arab customs, while the command to 'seek forgiveness' (istaghfir) for them underscores the Prophet's intercessory role and the communal nature of their spiritual status.
